method: Each engine ran the probe once: every code point from U+0000 to U+10FFFF except the surrogate range, as a one-character string, kept when String.prototype.trim() returned the empty string. The guard's JS_TRIM must equal this list (tests/test_memory_index_guard.py).
why_two_engines: The 2.1.300 client is a Bun build (its chunks are marked // @bun @bytecode), so Bun's engine is the one the loader runs on; Node is the second engine, and both return the same list.
python_str_strip_differs: Python's str.strip() with no argument also removes U+001C-U+001F and U+0085 and keeps U+FEFF, so the guard spells the set out by code point.
